firstRun.cause: Restored windows kept 640x480 while the reference had resized; restored viewport was subsequently initialized from the matching reference capture.

secondRun.cause: Python round uses ties-to-even, unlike positive Swift rounded() ties-away-from-zero. At 8.5 points and image scale one, the runner passed cell pixel width 8 instead of 9, causing a geometry rejection. Replaced with floor(x+0.5). This rejection is not evidence of an interprocess geometry change.

finalRun: Fresh build from verified-replay, guarded against retained accepted foundation hashes. See build.json and summary.json.
